svg.title: Scale & Spaces AI Studio — Affinity Designer v3 Master Residential, Commercial & Architectural Vector Kit (75+ Standalone Symbols)
svg.desc: 75+ isolated standalone vector CAD/illustrated symbols for Affinity Designer v3: Residential Living, Kitchen, Butler's Pantry, Laundry, Bath, Walk-in Closets, Bedrooms, Staircase Typologies, Doors/Windows (per 07Sketches & NBC 205:2024), Commercial Office/Retail/Cafe/Clinic/Fitness blocks, and World Architecture Landmarks.

g.text: Scale & Spaces AI Studio — Affinity Designer v3 Master Architectural & Commercial Vector Kit
ER. CHETAN KUMAR SARRAF · 75+ STANDALONE ISOLATED SYMBOLS (SERIF:ID) · RESIDENTIAL + COMMERCIAL + NBC 205 + 07SKETCHES STANDARDS
01 · STANDALONE ARCHITECTURAL SURFACE PATTERNS & FINISH SWATCHES (DRAG TO AFFINITY SWATCHES / ASSETS)
02 · LIVING ROOM, LOUNGE & FOYER STANDALONE SYMBOLS (CH. 1 & CH. 8 STANDARDS)
03 · MODULAR KITCHEN, WALK-IN BUTLER'S PANTRY & LAUNDRY SYMBOLS (CH. 2, CH. 3 & CH. 4)
04 · BATHROOM, WALK-IN CLOSET & BEDROOM STANDALONE SYMBOLS (CH. 5, CH. 6 & CH. 7)
05 · STAIRCASE TYPOLOGIES, DOORS & WINDOWS STANDALONE SYMBOLS (CH. 9 & CH. 10 + NBC 205)
06 · COMMERCIAL ARCHITECTURE SYMBOLS — CORPORATE OFFICE, RETAIL, CAFÉ, HEALTHCARE & FITNESS CENTRE
07 · HISTORY OF ARCHITECTURE STANDALONE VECTOR STAMPS (CH. 11 — TAJ MAHAL, VILLA SAVOYE, GUGGENHEIM, OPERA HOUSE, PANTHEON)
08 · ARCHITECTURAL DIMENSION & CLEARANCE SPECIFICATION SHEET (07SKETCHES + NBC 205:2024)
• Sofa to Coffee Table Clearance: 305 – 457 mm (12" – 18")
• Dining Chair Pull-Back + Walk Zone: 914 – 1067 mm (36" – 42")
• Rule: Frame ALL seating pieces on ONE large area rug (p.15)
• Work Triangle Leg: 1220 – 2700 mm | Total Sum: 3960 – 7920 mm
• Two-Cook Aisle Clearance: 1220 mm (4'-0") | One-Cook: 1066 mm
• Base Cabinet: D 600 × H 900 mm | Wall Unit: D 320–350 × H 740 mm
• Island Counter Overhang Legroom: ≥ 250 mm | Plinth Toe-Kick: 150 mm
• Butler's Walk-In Pantry Passage: ≥ 1000 – 1200 mm clear
• Laundry Front Loading Zone: ≥ 1060 mm (42") clear
• Enclosed Shower Min: 914 × 914 mm | WC Center-to-Wall: ≥ 430 mm
• Wheelchair / Accessible Turning Circle: Ø 1520 mm (5'-0")
• Reach-In Wardrobe Depth: 609 mm (2'-0") | Max 680 mm
• King Bed: 1930×2032 mm | Queen: 1524×2032 mm | Twin: 990×1905 mm
• Egress Window: Sill ≤ 1118 mm, Clear ≥ 0.53 m² (W≥508, H≥610)
• Ideal Riser: 152.4–190 mm (≤198 mm) | Tread: 270–304.8 mm
• Min Flight & Landing Width: 914 mm Res / 1200–1500 mm Comm
• Stair Handrail: 863–965 mm | Upper Guardrail: 1066 mm | Headroom ≥ 2032
• Baluster Max Clear Spacing: ≤ 99 mm (4" sphere rule)
• Commercial Corridor: ≥ 1500–1800 mm | Exit Door: ≥ 1000–1200 mm
• Passenger Elevator Core: ~2100–2400 mm square shaft
STANDALONE VECTOR STAIRCASE ELEVATION & RAILING TYPES (CABLE · TEMPERED GLASS · BALUSTER — CH. 9 P.89–90)
ER. CHETAN KUMAR SARRAF · SCALE & SPACES STUDIO
AFFINITY DESIGNER V3 MASTER VECTOR LIBRARY · 75+ STANDALONE ARCHITECTURAL & COMMERCIAL BLOCKS
Tip in Affinity Designer 3: Open the Layers Studio — every symbol is isolated with its own serif:id.
Select any group and click "Add from Selection" in the Assets Studio to build a reusable drag-and-drop CAD library.
